constraints.description: Must not freeze product delivery > 6 weeks for onboarding chaos

goals.description: Grow MRR >= 30% in 2 quarters without a bridge round

blue_r1.what: Hire all 3 now (2 eng + 1 AE) on day-one to maximize growth speed
blue_r1.rationale: Naive Blue: full hiring blast burns the whole quarterly budget immediately for speed.

red_r1.description: Onboarding overload: both eng hires ramp slowly; roadmap slips 8+ weeks while burn jumps
red_r1.rationale: Hard must_not: delivery freeze >6 weeks. Runway pressure starts as burn steps up with no revenue yet.

blue_r2.what: Patch: hire 1 senior eng first, delay AE 60 days, staged offers with 90-day ramp goals
blue_r2.rationale: Blue slows headcount to protect delivery cadence and keep runway above the floor.

red_r2.description: Sales pipeline softens: without AE, founder sales time collides with eng management
red_r2.rationale: Stresses growth goal — MRR trajectory dips — but staged hire still respects runway and delivery.

blue_r3.what: Add contractor AE for 8 weeks + hiring scorecard; keep FTE eng only until MRR +15%
blue_r3.rationale: Blue mixes flexible capacity with one FTE to chase growth without locking full burn.

red_r3.description: Contractor AE underperforms; CAC rises and runway math tightens if converted early to FTE
red_r3.rationale: Probes premature conversion to expensive FTE burn.

blue_r4.what: Gate second eng hire on shipping v1.2 + runway check; AE FTE only after 3 qualified demos/week
blue_r4.rationale: Milestone gates turn hiring into a controlled branch, not a hope bet.

red_r4.description: Key customer churn risk during transition; support load spikes on the lean team
red_r4.rationale: Operational stress without breaking hard runway if gates hold.

blue_r5.what: Final: staggered hire plan — 1 eng now, contractor AE, second eng at milestone; publish runway dashboard weekly
blue_r5.rationale: Survivor policy: growth with explicit kill-switches. Protects 6-month runway floor.

red_r5.description: Competitor ships similar feature; pressure to abandon gates and hire all three again
red_r5.rationale: Temptation attack: if Blue reverts to blast-hire, Red kills again on delivery freeze / runway.

baseline: ONE-SHOT BASELINE (no Red team): Hire all 3 immediately. Speed wins markets; payroll is an investment. Confidence: high. (Brittle — ignores onboarding chaos, delivery freeze, and the 6-month runway floor.)

memo.title: Recommend staged hiring with milestone gates
memo.recommended_reason: Full day-one hiring dies on delivery freeze and runway risk. The surviving branch hires one eng now, uses flexible AE capacity, and gates further FTEs on product + pipeline proof — keeping runway >= 6 months.
memo.kill_shots: R1 Red: blast-hiring 3 people froze delivery >6 weeks while burn stepped up with no revenue lift.
memo.open_risks: Contractor AE quality; competitor pressure to abandon gates; support load on a still-lean team.
memo.dissent: Growth-at-all-costs voices want the original 3-hire blast; Arbiter rejects because Red proved the hard delivery and runway breaks on that line.
